front.title: BBS and Modular Sub-proofs with JSON Web Proofs

abstract.t: This document defines a digital credential format that uses JSON Web Proofs (JWP) as its container format and Blind BBS Signatures as its signature scheme combined with a modular framework for attaching zero-knowledge sub-proofs. This allows a Holder to reveal some attributes directly while proving predicates such as range or equality over the ones they keep hidden. A credential can additionally be bound to a Holder-held device key, with possession of the key proven in every presentation without revealing the public key or signature. Concrete sub-proof and device-binding constructions are not defined in this document, only the core serialization. The credential type definition and data model follow SD-JWT VC.
